menthol.use: Used as a steam inhalation or rub to help relieve the feeling of a blocked nose.
warnings: Not for children under 2.
For external use / inhalation only; do not swallow.
Keep away from eyes.

dimenhydrinate.use: Used to prevent and relieve travel (motion) sickness.
warnings: Causes drowsiness — do not drive.
Take before travel as per label.
Caution in glaucoma, prostate problems, older adults.

nicotine.use: Used to reduce nicotine withdrawal symptoms and cravings when quitting smoking.
warnings: Seek advice in pregnancy, recent heart attack/stroke or unstable heart disease.
Use the "chew and park" technique for gum.
Combine with behavioural support for best results.

chlorhexMouth.use: Used as an antiseptic mouth rinse, e.g., for mouth ulcers or gum inflammation.
warnings: Do not swallow.
May temporarily stain teeth and alter taste.
Mouth ulcers lasting more than 3 weeks must be referred.

lidoGel.use: Used for temporary numbing relief of painful mouth ulcers in adults.
warnings: Not for teething infants or young children.
Avoid eating or drinking hot food until numbness wears off.
Refer ulcers lasting > 3 weeks or recurrent unexplained ulcers.

clotrimazole.use: Used for fungal skin infections such as athlete's foot, ringworm and fungal groin rash.
warnings: Continue for about 2 weeks after symptoms clear (as per label).
Keep the area clean and dry.
Refer nail infections, widespread infection, or diabetic foot problems.

terbinafine.use: Used for athlete's foot and other fungal skin infections.
warnings: For external use only.
Check label age limits.
Refer nail or widespread infections.

hydrocortisone.use: Used short-term for mild inflammatory skin conditions such as irritant dermatitis and insect bite reactions.
warnings: Do not use on the face, broken or infected skin unless advised.
Short courses only (as per label).
Children: use only on medical advice.

calamine.use: Used to soothe itchy or irritated skin, e.g., mild rashes, insect bites and mild sunburn.
warnings: For external use only.
Shake well before use.

aloe.use: Used as a cooling, moisturising after-sun gel for mild sunburned skin.
warnings: Cosmetic product — not a treatment for severe burns or blistering.
Seek help for extensive sunburn with fever, chills or blistering.

emollient.generic: Light liquid paraffin + White soft paraffin
emollient.use: Used to moisturise and protect dry, scaly skin (e.g., dry skin, eczema care).
warnings: Fire hazard: paraffin-based emollients can soak into clothing/bedding — keep away from flames.
Apply frequently and generously.

urea.use: Used to moisturise very dry, rough or thickened skin.
warnings: May sting on broken skin.
For external use only.

diclofenacGel.use: Used for local relief of muscle and joint pain, sprains and strains.
warnings: Do not apply to broken skin.
Do not use with NSAID/aspirin allergy or asthma triggered by aspirin/NSAIDs.
Avoid in the last trimester of pregnancy.
Wash hands after use.

salicylateRub.use: Used for temporary relief of minor muscle aches.
warnings: Contains a salicylate — avoid with aspirin/NSAID allergy.
Do not apply to broken skin or use with heat pads.
Not for young children.

benzoyl.use: Used for mild to moderate acne.
warnings: May cause dryness and irritation — start with lower strength.
Can bleach hair and fabrics.
Avoid eyes and lips.

sunscreen.use: Used to help protect skin from UV radiation (SPF indicates UVB protection; look for UVA rating too).
warnings: Apply generously and reapply every 2 hours and after swimming.
Babies under 6 months should be kept out of direct sun.

permethrin.use: Used to treat scabies (5% cream) and head lice (1% lotion).
warnings: Follow label application time precisely.
Close contacts may need treatment at the same time (scabies).
Seek advice for infants and in pregnancy.

dimeticone.use: Used to treat head lice by coating and suffocating lice.
warnings: Repeat after 7 days as per label.
Flammable until dry — keep away from flames.
Check all family members.

ketoShampoo.use: Used for dandruff and seborrhoeic dermatitis of the scalp.
warnings: Leave on scalp for the time stated on the label before rinsing.
Avoid contact with eyes.

iodine.use: Used to clean minor cuts, scrapes and wounds to reduce the risk of infection.
warnings: Avoid with iodine allergy or thyroid disorders.
Avoid prolonged use in pregnancy, breastfeeding and newborns.
Deep, dirty or large wounds need medical care.

chlorhexAntiseptic.use: Used for cleansing minor cuts, grazes and skin before first aid dressing.
warnings: For external use only.
Avoid eyes and ears.
Seek medical care for animal bites, deep or dirty wounds.

plaster.use: Used to cover and protect minor cuts and grazes.
warnings: Clean the wound before applying.
Change daily or if wet/dirty.
Check for adhesive sensitivity.

gauze.use: Used to clean and cover wounds and to apply pressure to stop minor bleeding.
warnings: Single use; keep sterile until use.
Uncontrolled bleeding is an emergency.

crepe.use: Used to provide light support and compression for minor sprains and strains.
warnings: Do not wrap too tightly — check circulation (numbness, tingling, colour change).
Remove at night unless advised.

cotton.use: Used for cleaning skin and applying lotions.
warnings: Do not leave fibres in open wounds.

tape.use: Used to secure dressings to skin.
warnings: Remove gently to avoid skin damage.

coldPack.use: Used to apply cold to minor sprains, bumps and bruises to reduce swelling.
warnings: Wrap in cloth — do not apply directly to skin.
Apply for short periods (e.g., 15–20 minutes).

burnGel.use: Used to cover minor burns after cooling the burn under cool running water.
warnings: First cool the burn under cool running water for about 20 minutes.
Large, deep, facial, hand, genital or electrical/chemical burns need urgent care.
Do not apply ice, butter or toothpaste.

wipes.use: Used to clean skin and equipment (e.g., thermometer tips).
warnings: Flammable.
Stings on broken skin; not for wound beds.

firstAidKit.use: Contains basic dressings, tape, gloves and antiseptic wipes for minor injuries.
warnings: Check and replace expired items regularly.
